name: admin.apps.mcp.servers.permissions.set
purpose: Set the access control permission for who can use an MCP server

server_id.desc: Encoded ID of the MCP server.

permission_type.desc: The type of permission that defines who can use this MCP server.

user_ids.desc: List of user IDs to set for named_entities or named_entities_exclude.
